江南749局总部大院，夜色渐浓。

白日里人声汇聚的大厅已然安静下来，各路队员各自分到专属厢房休整，调息养气，打磨法器，为明日北上东北做足准备。

胡九郎独自立于院中青石长廊之下，晚风微凉，吹动黑衣衣袂。他抬头望着夜空星月，指尖轻轻摩挲怀中那枚碎裂的护身符，神色沉静落寞。

小队全员集结，阵容齐备，明日便要奔赴冰天雪地的东北，直面三大东瀛邪派的虎狼之巢。前路凶险莫测，生死难料，他早已看淡。

只是心底那道关于杨童的执念，始终无法彻底放下。

“九郎先生。”

身后传来轻柔的脚步声，林佳缓步走来，手里拿着一份整理好的东北路线图与物资清单。

“明日一早七点出发，专属物资列车直达东北沈阳分局，避开世俗耳目，全程由749局专人护送。”林佳将图纸递给他，“沿途会经过几处煞气较重的山林路段，我已经标注出来，到时候还要劳烦你推演风水，避开邪煞聚集地。”

胡九郎接过图纸，随意扫了一眼，点头：“无妨，交给我便可。”

林佳站在他身侧，沉默片刻，终究还是忍不住轻声开口：“你……还放不下杨童？”

晚风微顿，胡九郎眼底掠过一丝黯然，没有否认，也没有承认，只是淡淡道：“逝者已矣，只是执念难平。”

“我懂。”林佳轻叹一声，眼神带着几分释然与心疼，“当初我也心悦于你，可看到你和杨童之间的情愫，我便早已放手。如今只盼你此行北上，能活着归来，别困在过往里，蹉跎自身道心。”

她早已放下儿女情长，如今只以队友、友人身份，真心盼他平安。

胡九郎侧头看了她一眼，淡淡颔首：“多谢挂念，我自有分寸。”

两人静静站在长廊之下，望着夜空星月，无言相伴，气氛淡然平和。

就在这时，胡九郎手机微微震动。

他拿出老旧的智能机，屏幕亮起，是魔都阡陌发来的消息。

只有短短几句话：师父，汐汐姐今天来了卦铺，问你什么时候回去，担心你被749局牵连出事。我按你的嘱咐转告了财运之事，汐汐姐一直放心不下你，说若是有机会，想再见你一面。

胡九郎看着消息，沉默片刻，回复一句：俗世因果暂且了结，不必挂念，我此行远行，归期未定。

发完消息，收起手机，心底掠过一丝感慨。

魔都小巷卦铺，阡陌、汐汐，都是他下山红尘里为数不多的善意与烟火。如今再度入世奔赴险境，俗世牵绊，只能暂且放下。

可他没想到，没过多久，大院门口传来通报，有人专程来访，指名要见胡九郎。

In the courtyard of Jiangnan Bureau 749 headquarters, the night is getting darker.

The hall where people gathered during the day has become quiet. Team members from all walks of life have been assigned to their own private rooms to rest, adjust their breath and nourish their energy, polish their magic weapons, and prepare for their journey north to the Northeast tomorrow.

Hu Jiulang stood alone under the bluestone corridor in the courtyard, with the cool evening breeze blowing his black clothes.He looked up at the stars and moon in the night sky, his fingertips gently caressing the broken amulet in his arms, his expression calm and lonely.

The team is all assembled, and the lineup is ready. Tomorrow, they will rush to the ice-covered Northeast and face the den of tigers and wolves of the three major Japanese evil sects.The road ahead is dangerous and unpredictable, life and death are unpredictable, and he has long been bearish.

It's just that the obsession with Yang Tong in my heart can never be completely let go.

"Mr. Kuro."

There were soft footsteps behind him, and Lin Jia walked slowly, holding a compiled Northeast route map and supplies list in her hand.

"Departing at seven o'clock tomorrow morning, the exclusive material train will go directly to the Northeast Shenyang Branch, avoiding the eyes and ears of the world, and will be escorted by dedicated personnel from the 749 Bureau." Lin Jia handed him the drawing. "There will be several mountainous and forest sections with strong evil spirits along the way. I have marked them. I will also trouble you to deduce Feng Shui and avoid evil gathering places."

Hu Jiulang took the drawing, glanced at it casually, and nodded: "It doesn't matter, just leave it to me."

Lin Jia stood beside him and was silent for a moment. Finally, she couldn't help but speak softly: "You... still can't let go of Yang Tong?"

There was a slight pause in the evening breeze, and a trace of sadness flashed across Hu Jiulang's eyes. He did not deny it, nor did he admit it. He just said lightly: "The deceased is gone. It's just that the obsession is hard to let go."

"I understand." Lin Jia sighed softly, with a bit of relief and heartache in her eyes, "I was also happy with you at the beginning, but when I saw the affection between you and Yang Tong, I let it go. Now I just hope that you will go north and come back alive, and don't be stuck in the past and waste your Taoism."

She has long since put aside her love for her son and daughter, and now only regards him as a teammate and friend, sincerely hoping that he is safe.

Hu Jiulang glanced sideways at her and nodded lightly: "Thank you for your concern. I have my own sense of discretion."

The two of them stood quietly under the corridor, looking at the stars and moon in the night sky, silently accompanying each other, and the atmosphere was calm and peaceful.

At this moment, Hu Jiulang's phone vibrated slightly.

He took out his old smartphone, and the screen lit up, showing a message from Qianmo, the capital city.

There are only a few words: Master, Sister Xixi came to Guapu today and asked you when you would go back. She was worried that you would be implicated in Bureau 749 and something would happen.I told you about the fortune as you asked. Sister Xixi has always been worried about you and said that if there is a chance, she would like to see you again.

Hu Jiulang read the news, was silent for a moment, and replied: The worldly cause and effect has been settled for the time being, so there is no need to worry about it. I am traveling far away and my return date has not yet been determined.

After sending the message, I put away my phone and felt a trace of emotion in my heart.

The Gua Pu, Qianmo, and Xixi in the alleys of the magic city are all the few goodwill and fireworks he has left in the world of mortals.Now that I have entered the world again and run into danger, I can only let go of the ties of the world for the time being.

But he didn't expect that not long after, a notice came from the gate of the compound that someone came to visit specifically and wanted to see Hu Jiulang.
